mapper.select: SELECT result FROM ( SELECT result, created_at, id, 0 AS precedence FROM moderation_decisions WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND entity_type = 'CHAPTER' AND entity_id = CAST(#{chapterId} AS text) UNION ALL SELECT md.result, md.created_at, md.id, 1 AS precedence FROM moderation_decisions md JOIN chapters c ON c.id = #{chapterId} JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id WHERE md.project_id = #{projectId} AND md.entity_type = 'STORY_VERSION' AND md.entity_id = sv.id::text UNION ALL SELECT CASE WHEN sv.moderation_decision = 'SAFE' THEN 'ALLOW' ELSE sv.moderation_decision END, CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, sv.id, 2 AS precedence FROM chapters c JOIN story_versions sv ON sv.id = c.story_version_id WHERE c.id = #{chapterId} AND sv.project_id = #{projectId} ) decisions ORDER BY precedence ASC, created_at DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
